parts.label: (a)(i)
parts.stem: GLP-1 binds to receptors on cell surface membranes of $\beta$ cells in the pancreas. These cells secrete insulin.
parts.text: Name the type of membrane component that forms a receptor in the cell surface membrane.

parts.label: (a)(ii)
parts.text: State how GLP-1 is transported to the pancreas.

parts.label: (b)
parts.stem: GLP-1 inhibits the secretion of glucagon by $\alpha$ cells in the pancreas.
parts.text: Describe **two** processes in the liver that are stimulated by glucagon.

parts.label: (c)
parts.text: Suggest **one** reason why GLP-1 causes a decrease in appetite.

parts.label: (d)
parts.stem: GLP-1 inhibits the emptying of the stomach. This is an example of negative feedback.
parts.text: Explain what is meant by negative feedback.

parts.label: (e)
parts.stem: A transcription factor is involved in the production of GLP-1. An insertion mutation in the gene that codes for the transcription factor can affect the production of GLP-1.
parts.text: Outline the effect of an insertion mutation on the production of GLP-1.
